_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: On the night before he died, he prayed for us.
Holy Father, keep them in your name.
He prayed that we might all be one.
As you and I are one.
We are in the world but not of it.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
Come, let us worship, held in his prayer.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!

registers.label: Immersive
lines: Come and stand inside a prayer older than your worry, the prayer Jesus prayed for you the night before he died.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
Holy Father, keep them, he prayed; guard them in your name; make them one as we are one.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
You are not left as orphans in this world; you are planted like a tree beside the water, your roots in the stream that does not fail.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
So abide in his joy made full, sent into the world but never let go.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: He prayed for us the night before he died.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
Holy Father, keep them in your name.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
Make us one, as you and he are one.
Christ is risen, Alleluia!
Come, let us worship, held in his prayer.
We are kept in his name. Alleluia!
